description: Legitimate-repeat fixtures and one heterogeneous-object fixture for repetition_collapse. Each fixture carries an explicit expected_label: 'loop' means the buffer is a degenerate repetition collapse the detector MUST flag; 'allow' means the buffer is a legitimate repeating structure the detector MUST NOT flag. The detector output is compared byte-for-byte across runs.

fixtures.comment: ASCII art inside a fenced block repeats the same line many times - must be suppressed.
